profile.name: 图形标注与ROI对象
profile.description: 用于科学成像软件中的图形标注与感兴趣区域（ROI）对象，可表示矩形、椭圆、直线、点、环形、楔形等覆盖图形。它通常用于显微图像或谱图上的区域选择、测量、掩膜生成、交互编辑和结果标注。
profile.description_en: A graphic annotation and region-of-interest (ROI) object used in scientific imaging software. It can represent overlays such as rectangles, ellipses, lines, points, rings, and wedges, and is typically used on microscopy images or spectra for region selection, measurement, mask generation, interactive editing, and annotation.
